notes: Adenine / L-tryptophan supplementation treated as medium supplement (treatment none); anaerobic is an oxygen condition, not a treatment. Every wild-type MG1655 sample (each medium/oxygen condition) is a control. KO strains are BW25113 derivatives while WT is MG1655. Anaerobic culture mode (serum bottles) left out. WT re-read: wild type MG1655, genotype_class wild_type.

growth_temperature.q: E. coli cultures were grown at 37 °C in M9 minimal media with glucose as the primary carbon source and harvested at mid exponetial phase.

treatment.q: Each dual perturbation experiment consists of four RNA-seq samples (WT, WT+nutrient supplementation, transcription factor KO, transcription factor KO+nutrient supplementation).

inducer_added.q: Each dual perturbation experiment consists of four RNA-seq samples (WT, WT+nutrient supplementation, transcription factor KO, transcription factor KO+nutrient supplementation).

transcription_arrested.q: Each dual perturbation experiment consists of four RNA-seq samples (WT, WT+nutrient supplementation, transcription factor KO, transcription factor KO+nutrient supplementation).

mixed_organism.q: We sequenced mRNA of three dual perturbation experiments of E. coli K12 MG1655

assay_class.q: rRNA was removed with Epicentre’s Ribo-Zero rRNA Removal Kit.

rrna_removal.q: rRNA was removed with Epicentre’s Ribo-Zero rRNA Removal Kit.

culture_mode.q: Aerobic E. coli conditions were grown in shake flasks

oxygen.q: anaerobic conditions were grown in anoxic serum bottles
